content.short: AltLayer is a decentralized and elastic RaaS protocol that helps developers launch scalable Layer 2 execution layers.
content.description: AltLayer is a decentralized and elastic Rollup-as-a-Service (RaaS) protocol designed for application developers to launch scalable, application-tailored Layer 2 execution layers. It provides a developer-focused SDK for those who want to manage their own rollups, and a no-code dashboard that enables users with varying levels of coding experience to spin up a customized execution layer in as little as two minutes with just a few clicks.
content.meta: AltLayer is a decentralized and elastic RaaS protocol for launching scalable Layer 2 execution layers. Discover AltLayer and other RaaS Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
